span.p:
Objective (cloud-neutral)
provision · deploy · investigate · restore ·
scale · migrate · diagnose · verify

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Agent Harness
ZERO cloud awareness (CI-enforced:
no cloud SDK imports, no cloud literals)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Normalized resource model
compute · storage · db · network · k8s ·
serverless · functions · identity · telemetry · lb

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Credential broker (per org, short-lived)
AssumeRole · workload identity · service principals ·
never one global key set

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PARITY GATE (CI)
a service family ships only when all 3 packs
expose the same verb set:
discover · inspect · create · update · lifecycle ·
scale · delete · troubleshoot · verify
